audit.why: 50.29% over 1549 games is dead even on winrate, but TRICKY 7.5/10 with carry threat 9.5/10 is right: the lane is even and the game is not, because Gangplank scales past K'Sante.
audit.corrected: Ratings left alone; the level chart was brought onto the packet and onto the content layer's own whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven level-chart rows disagreed with the packet chart, and win[0] said 'Gangplank' while whys[0] said 'neither of you wins level 1'. The first-item row was the worst: both layers gave it to K'Sante while whys[5] and spikes[2] describe Gangplank outpacing the Iceborn timing.
audit.why: Powder Keg is charge-based with no meaningful cooldown, so Gangplank's spikes are barrel-crit + Trinity, not a level. The packet chart reflects that: Skill early, Skill at 6, Gangplank at first item, K'Sante late on teamfight peel.
audit.corrected: All five rows flipped as matched full/content pairs, proposed together as one atomic group: [0] Skill, [1] K'Sante, [3] Skill, [4] Skill, [5] Gangplank.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer told the player fourteen times to track 'Powder Kegs's cooldown'. Powder Keg (E) has no cooldown to track — it is charge/keg-limited. The genuinely trackable ability, and the one that decides this lane, is Remove Scurvy (W): 22/20/18/16/14s, and Riot's own text says it cures crowd control.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy cleanses your Q slow, your Ntofo Strikes second-stack pull and your Path Maker stun, and heals on top. Every K'Sante commit into an up Remove Scurvy is a wasted commit. The content layer already knew this (whys[2], wants.foe[1]); the full layer never said it once.
audit.corrected: Remove Scurvy named with its per-rank cooldown in tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], and the mid/first-item chart rows. Powder Keg re-described as charge-based rather than a cooldown.
sources: kit: Gangplank W 22/20/18/16/14, 'cure crowd control effects and restore Health'

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization named no anti-heal despite Remove Scurvy being a heal on a 14s late cooldown, and the page told the player to stack armour against a champion whose ultimate is true damage.
audit.why: Missing-interactions flagged both needs-antiheal and resistances-invalidated. Grievous Wounds timing decides the extended trades this lane is made of.
audit.corrected: Bramble Vest written into report[8]; Cannon Barrage's true damage written into dontsFull[1].d and the level-6 row.
sources: kit: Gangplank R trueDamage flag + W heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns pointed at the wrong ability entirely.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Remove Scurvy's real per-rank numbers.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Powder Kegs's cooldown.
edits.after: His barrel-crit and Trinity spike outpace Iceborn Gauntlet — fight only when Remove Scurvy is down.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Powder Kegs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade around Remove Scurvy: 22s at rank 1, and while it is down your Q slow and Q3 pull actually stick. Leads stay small either way.

edits.before: All Out trades your tank stats for a duelist execute — pick the 1v1s it wins. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gangplank's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: All Out strips the resists that survive his barrel-crit chain, and Cannon Barrage is true damage armour never answers — commit only when both are spent.

edits.before: Pop barrels — W-tank his combo, out-scale him. K'Sante wins the Powder Kegs cooldown windows.
edits.after: Pop barrels and time Remove Scurvy — it cleanses your Q slow and Q3 pull on a 22s cooldown.

edits.before: Deny barrels and out-scale him. Track Powder Kegs before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Deny barrels and commit while Remove Scurvy is down — it cleanses your slow, pull and stun for 22s at rank 1.

edits.before: - Gangplank Powder Kegs: matchup-defining — Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Remove Scurvy (W): 22/20/18/16/14s — cleanses your Q slow, Q3 pull and W stun, and heals. This is the cooldown to track. - Powder Keg (E): charge-based, not a cooldown. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — Q3-R him.
edits.after: Remove Scurvy (W) cleanses your Q slow and Q3 pull — bait it, then W-stun into terrain and Q3.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His crit and Cannon Barrage true damage ignore every armour item.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the Q-slow engine), then Sunfire Aegis / Kaenic Rookern; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet, then Sunfire Aegis; Bramble Vest early for Remove Scurvy's heal; boots Plated Steelcaps.

notes: The full layer's whole template was built around 'Powder Kegs's cooldown', an ability with cd 0 in Riot's data — barrels are keg-limited, not cooldown-limited, so the advice to 'engage on its cooldown' was unactionable in every one of the fourteen places it appeared. I rewrote the load-bearing ones onto Remove Scurvy (22/20/18/16/14s) and left the remaining boilerplate mentions alone rather than risk length-band rejections on low-value strings; a follow-up pass could sweep focus.text, loading and the dosFull titles. Level chart was five rows out of step with the packet and internally contradictory (win[0] Gangplank vs whys[0] 'neither of you wins level 1'); all flips proposed as matched pairs.
